infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: KidSync needs access to your contacts so you can invite and coordinate carpools and events with other parents.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: KidSync allows you to sync club fixtures, parties, and booked events directly into your phone calendar.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow KidSync to access your contacts to easily invite and coordinate carpools with parents.

plugins.calendarPermission: Allow KidSync to sync booked matches and parties to your calendar.
